title: calophyllum microphyllum
intro: Calophyllum microphyllum, commonly known as the Sabah calophyllum or Sabah tree, is a plant species native to Borneo. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, pain, and fever, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Calophyllum microphyllum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include calophyllic acid, calophyllum oil, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
